# Vector Search

Embedding-based similarity search -- approximate nearest neighbor algorithms, indexing strategies, and hybrid scoring.

## When to Load

- Implementing semantic search or recommendation systems
- Choosing between HNSW and IVF index types
- Combining vector similarity with keyword filters
- Optimizing recall/latency tradeoffs

## Key Concepts

**Embeddings** -- Dense vector representations of content (text, images, code). Generated by models (OpenAI, Cohere, sentence-transformers). Dimensionality typically 384-1536.

**HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World)** -- Graph-based ANN algorithm. Best recall, higher memory. Parameters: M (connections per node, 16 default), ef_construction (build quality), ef_search (query quality vs speed).

**IVF (Inverted File Index)** -- Partition-based ANN. Lower memory, requires training. Parameters: nlist (number of partitions), nprobe (partitions to search). Good for very large datasets.

**Distance Metrics** -- Cosine similarity (normalized text), Euclidean/L2 (spatial), dot product (when magnitudes matter). Choose based on how embeddings were trained.

**Hybrid Scoring** -- Combine BM25 keyword score with vector similarity. Methods: reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), linear combination, re-ranking. Usually outperforms either alone.

## Patterns

```json
// Elasticsearch dense_vector mapping
{
  "content_embedding": {
    "type": "dense_vector",
    "dims": 1536,
    "index": true,
    "similarity": "cosine",
    "index_options": {
      "type": "hnsw",
      "m": 16,
      "ef_construction": 100
    }
  }
}

// Hybrid search with RRF
{
  "retriever": {
    "rrf": {
      "retrievers": [
        { "standard": { "query": { "match": { "content": "user query" } } } },
        { "knn": { "field": "embedding", "query_vector": [...], "k": 20 } }
      ],
      "rank_window_size": 50
    }
  }
}
```

```python
# pgvector with Python
from pgvector.sqlalchemy import Vector

class Document(Base):
    embedding = Column(Vector(1536))

# Query with cosine distance
results = session.scalars(
    select(Document)
    .order_by(Document.embedding.cosine_distance(query_vector))
    .limit(10)
)
```

## Gotchas

- Embedding model and search model must match -- you cannot mix OpenAI embeddings with a Cohere-trained index
- HNSW recall drops with high M values if ef_search is not increased proportionally
- IVF needs retraining when data distribution shifts significantly
- Cosine vs dot product: if embeddings are not normalized, cosine and dot product give different results
- Pre-filtering by metadata before ANN can drastically reduce candidate pool, hurting recall

## Verification

- Measure recall@k against a ground truth set (brute-force kNN on a sample)
- Monitor p99 latency as index grows -- HNSW degrades slowly, IVF can cliff
- Validate embedding dimensions match between model output and index configuration
- A/B test hybrid vs pure vector vs pure keyword on real user queries
- Check that filtered queries still return enough candidates (min 10x final k)
